effects.display_name: Clawdian charge terrain removal/debris
effects.actual_behavior: Raw5/server invokes helper if config ignoreMobGriefing (installed false) OR native EventHooks.canEntityGrief. Scan inflated bbox(.5,.2,.5) from floor(selfY) to bboxMaxY. Each nonair block must canEntityDestroy, !CLAWDIAN_IMMUNE and onEntityDestroyBlock true. Native destroyBlock(pos,false,self) always attempted. RNG nextInt6==0 and no block entity additionally creates decorative debris life20, motion using (selfPos-debrisPos)*((-1.2+U)/3,.2+Gaussian*.15,(-1.2+U)/3), then spawn even if destroyBlock returned false. effects.display_name: Elite native crossbow charging/raw-state sequence
effects.actual_behavior: Priority1 ReloadGoal binds required0/active1/end1/max30/look15/range12. canUse requires target, RNG*100<22F, alive, strict distance<12, raw0, holding CrossbowItem and !localCharging. Start sets raw1; stop sets raw1 again; inherited setAttackState resets attackTicks even for same value. Continue raw1 && attackTicks<=30. Before look15 tracks target then locks previous yaw; attackTicks==5 starts item use in native CrossbowItem hand. Each goal tick, when getTicksUsingItem>=CrossbowItem.getChargeDuration(useItem,self), releaseUsingItem then setChargingCrossbow(true), independent of whether native ammunition loading succeeded; no invented fixed charge duration. Local enum crossbowState UNCHARGED is assigned by constructor but has no subsequent reader/writer; excludes it as dead state instead of inventing a second state machine. Raw ATTACK_STATE/local charging and native weapon CHARGED_PROJECTILES are separate.

effects.display_name: Ender Golem awake and deactivation prerequisites
effects.actual_behavior: Synced IS_AWAKEN defaults false; its Boolean setter only writes the accessor and does not heal, reset timers, or change animations. After parent tick, deactivateProgress rises by 1 while dormant and <30, or falls by 1 while awake and >0. The later tick attack-dispatch block requires exactly zero progress and isAlive; payloads/selection are deferred. These progress updates have no local side/NoAI/alive gate. At the end of server tick, timeWithoutTarget increments. Any non-null target resets it and awakens a dormant entity without an explicit target-alive check. Strictly >400 targetless ticks while awake reset the timer and set awake false; no local NoAI/alive gate is added. Native HurtByTarget and Player/IronGolem NearestAttackableTarget registrations supply targets; original native goal admission remains. No separate concrete HP phase/shield/armor-state setter is declared. Animation-dependent reduction is separate from this Boolean; animation offense stays R2k11b.

effects.display_name: Endermaptera ceiling navigation and acceleration
effects.actual_behavior: UP first adds Y=1 but then sets noGravity=true and overwrites movement with old velocity*(0.7,1,0.7), so the +1 write is not an independent net ascent. Server switches UP to FlightMoveController(0.6F,false) and DirectPathNavigator, otherwise ordinary MoveControl/WallClimberNavigation. Active flight has no Y support and faces motion; MOVE_TO adds normalized destination vector*speedModifier*0.6F*0.05 or stops within bounding-box size and halves velocity. Direct navigation moveTo writes destination and returns true; its tick only increments the counter. Flight does not call its parent tick or unused canReach helper.

effects.actual_behavior: CHARGE_ATTACHMENT registry bootstrap6 -> lambda$static$2 -> bootstrap3 ChargeAttachment constructor; builder.build only, no serializer/copy-on-death configured here. Constructor defaults chargefalse/fields0; raw setters unchanged. WallWatcher registered cataclysm:wall_watcher (native MISCsized0x0/noSummon/fireImmune). effects.display_name: Gauntlet of Guard native sustained AABB full-vector pull
effects.actual_behavior: onUseTick uses usingEntity.level(), queries LivingEntity in user bounding box inflated11 in every axis, with no added radial/LOS/owner/team/self exclusion. Only Player with abilities.invulnerable is skipped. For every other recipient, diff=normalize(recipient.position-user.position)*0.1; setDeltaMovement(oldVelocity-diff). Full Y direction is retained; coincident native normalization remains native. This is a per-use-callback velocity contribution, not vanilla knockback: no explicit knockback event/KBR read, no hurt, status, healing, projectile or owner substitution. Movement loop precedes the client-only particle branch and has no local server gate. Native recipient setter/collision/use interruption remain native.

effects.display_name: Guardian remaining attack selection and native followups
effects.actual_behavior: tick chooses a random one of four punches every invocation before branch admission. Reuses locked mass/airstrike/vortex/Hug selection priority. Remaining idle/live-target/AI branches: distance<2.75 selects burst with nextInt(6)==0, otherwise random punch; at strict 2.75<distance<4.3, actual LEVITATION OR STUN selects the phase-specific uppercut before stomp/random selection. Otherwise stomp requires cooldown<=0 and grounded target, with strict 6<distance<13 and random<10%, or 2.75<distance<4.3 and random<2%; writes cooldown400. Remaining middle-distance random branch selects uppercut on nextInt(4)==0. Uppercut writes200 and decrements it but never reads it for admission. Punch goals at left tick24/right26 may change to matching swing on random nextInt(2)==0 and distance<=4. Vortex goal tick37 changes to rocket punch if target distanceSquared>=25, regardless of successful vortex creation. Native animation identity is the binary gate.

effects.display_name: Guardian staged bullet motion, damage and Levitation
effects.actual_behavior: Both uppercut goals call Bulletpattern; with target at animationTick54 it creates9 owned bullets (i=-4..4), staging near floored target X/Z at targetY+0.1 (minus1 only if airborne, not in water and unsupported). Cardinal direction comes from boss/target block X/Z. Native delay30 stages velocity=(start-current)/remainingTimer; when timer<=0 first sets fired=true, velocity0 and timer30. Fired server ticks add dir*0.1 only while velocity²<=16; later timeout discards. It overrides tick without super.tick and uses move-vector collision, inherited canHitEntity and posted/cancellable projectile impact. Unfired impacts do not deliver payload/discard. Fired server entity hit requests mobProjectile6; hurt=true alone invokes enchantment post-attack effects then adds literal LEVITATION100/0 to LivingEntity with no explicit effect source. Fired impact discards regardless of hurt/effect success. Fired hurt callback server-discard returns true; unfired hurt returns true without discard; canBeCollidedWith=false.

effects.display_name: Guardian death callback and native respawner linkage
effects.actual_behavior: Reuses shared cancelled/credited death callback admission. Guardian getDeathAnimation returns FALLEN196; shared LLibrary duration is196-20=176. onDeathAIUpdate calls super then zeroes horizontal motion retaining Y. AfterDefeatBoss with configured respawner=true, server, existing home and resolvable home dimension invokes Respawner at home X/Z with searchY homeY..homeY-10. Native code reads support/collision from current boss level but writes target home level; places BOSS_RESPAWNER with update flag2 even if no support (fallback maxY). Stores ENDER_GUARDIAN type and VOID_EYE requirement. Matching native item use lights block/consumes1; nearby alive player radius9, LIT, nonpeaceful server and animation counter>=19 attempt spawn. Native spawn finalizes SPAWNER and sets home; destroys respawner only on successful addFreshEntity. It does not call setUsedMassDestruction(false), so fresh Guardian retains the locked used=true default unlike altar spawn.

effects.display_name: Guardian vortex pull and terminal native explosion
effects.actual_behavior: BLACKHOLE goal tick26 with target searches sturdy support under target X/Z between min(targetY,bossY) and max+1; on support creates Guardian-owned Void_Vortex lifespan300. Native tick, without local side guard, pulls while min(tickCount,currentLifespan)>=16 in AABB X/Z ±3,Y[0,15]. Exclude vortex allies, current cached owner/owner allies and Player invulnerable ability; velocity += (0,-2,0)-normalize(recipientPos-vortexPos)*0.075. Lifespan decrements each tick; <=0 invokes Level.explode(owner,power2,fire=false,NONE) then discards. No ally predicate surrounds the terminal native explosion. Fresh owner is Guardian: native direct/causing explosion actors are Guardian, not vortex; literal player_explosion is selected despite nonplayer owner. Saved CasterId is runtime integer, not UUID. Server tick directly reads owner and does not call getOwner; after ordinary load it may remain null, changing pull exclusions and explosion actors/type to ownerless explosion.

effects.display_name: Harbinger activation progress and native AI hold
effects.actual_behavior: IS_ACT synced default is true; setIsAct only stores the flag and boss-event visibility. aiStep on both sides snapshots old progress; inactive with progress<40 writes40 immediately, active with progress>0 subtracts1. Flag setter does not write progress, health or home. Positive progress alone gates ordinary incoming hurt. Priority0 AwakenGoal canUse iff progress>0, owns MOVE/JUMP/LOOK, updates every tick, and writes velocity(0,currentY,0). canBeSeenAsEnemy requires getIsAct and native superclass predicate. Concrete customServerAiStep skips superclass and the active body while inactive or positive awakening progress.

It does not explode solely at age500 without collision. Pickable radius1; hurt rejects virtual native invulnerability, then markHurt; causing entity nonnull+fired returns true and server sets velocity to causing look vector,power*.1D,owner=causing entity. effects.display_name: Ignis native team and same-class predicate distinctions
effects.actual_behavior: isAlliedTo returns true for self, then native super team alliance, then TEAM_IGNIS tagged type only when both teams null. This is reused by body-check/poke/waves/local contact/phase/STUN/owned Flame Strike; AreaAttack sword helper deliberately has no ally reader. Flame Strike checks mutual nonalliance with its resolved caster.

effects.display_name: Ignis sword-area damage, burn, Brand and heal package
effects.actual_behavior: Each recorded aiStep animation/tick calls AreaAttack exactly with the retained profile. Server nearby Living selection uses native radial/cube helper and a horizontal wrap-angle test. Formula float(A*double(dm)+double(maxHP*hpFraction(float))) is one mob_attack request per admitted victim. All Ignis entities are excluded, but this helper has NO isAlliedTo test. Blocked Player shield disable when positive is independent of hurtreturn. True return ignites; positive Brand duration uses locked raw remove/stack+1 cap4 then addEffect with no source, then heals coefficient*float(HealingMultiplier)*(selectedAmp+1), regardless of addEffect result and alive-after-hurt. Combo true latches once/increments CanSpin; positive airborne addsY. No enchantment post-attack callback.

effects.display_name: Ignis ordered offensive selection and follow-ups
effects.actual_behavior: Concrete tick decrements positive native cooldowns once, then unconditionally draws nextInt(3) for the poke choice. Locked phase/shield transition priority precedes offense. Alive AI idle actor with an alive target enters the ordered selection table; full stance means blockingProgress==10 OR swordProgress==10 except the second high-target MAGIC alternative. Native random draws short-circuit in order, not independent global proc rates. Normal/soul reinforced choice is nextInt(2), independent of phase. Horizontal swing writes cooldown160 but does not read it for entry. Goal follow-ups use existing animation state and target/motion predicates; STUN is only the locked effect-presence reader here.

Alive AI idle actor with an alive target enters the ordered selection table; full stance means blockingProgress==10 OR swordProgress==10 except the second high-target MAGIC alternative. Native random draws short-circuit in order, not independent global proc rates. Normal/soul reinforced choice is nextInt(2), independent of phase. Horizontal swing writes cooldown160 but does not read it for entry. Goal follow-ups use existing animation state and target/motion predicates; STUN is only the locked effect-presence reader here.

effects.actual_behavior: Only nonnull direct entity, AI enabled and blockingProgress==10 OR swordProgress==10 enter the reactive block. With alive target, NO_ANIMATION, nextFloat*100<12, counter cooldown<=0 and causing squared range<225, set cooldown360 then animation COUNTER or SHIELD_BREAK_COUNTER according to break flag. Counter ticks>16<=46 send STRIKE; broken counter ticks>8<=38 send SHIELD_BREAK_STRIKE. Each transition occurs before returning false unless BYPASSES_INVULNERABILITY. No shared hurt success is required for selection or transitions; later offensive strike payloads are deferred.

effects.actual_behavior: getDeathAnimation returns IGNIS_DEATH duration124; locked shared death progression uses duration-20 removal threshold104. effects.display_name: Ignis offensive motion and animation chains
effects.actual_behavior: Priority1 offensive goals claim MOVE/JUMP/LOOK; idle AttackMoveGoal priority2 pursues but has no melee/damage call. Body-check normal writes target displacement*.25 at20, soul*.4F at16, Y0. Air smash writes target XZ displacement*.15,Y1.3 at19 (no target Y1.4) then onGround after19 ->SMASH. Reinforced variants do the same at84 (no target Y1.8), land after84 -> matching normal/soul smash. Horizontal/poke goals add forward*.3*clamped distance (clamps10/15; poke no-target adds unit forward); combo1 adds forward*.35*clamp(distance,0,5) at15/36/71, then target-nonnull at84 ->COMBO2. Predictive uppercut/combo2 snapshot initial targetXZ; before charge27 compute floor(currentXZ+(currentXZ-initialXZ)/27*12), then at27 write displacement*.3F,Y0 and clear target vector; stop also clears it. Uppercut retains target captured at goal start; combo2 rereads current target. Small swings/combo2 add forward1.5 at native ticks, subject to target-distance>3.5 where specified. Forced facing/zeroXZ preserve native windows. Before selection, floatStrider native lava support may setOnGround(true), feeding the air-smash landing gate; otherwise velocity is halved plus randomFloat*.5Y. Native canStandOnFluid accepts lava, with fluid affected/push overrides false. tick also calls the locked native repelEntities(1.4F,4F,1.4F,1.4F); its helper and native target pushes are reused, not new damage.

effects.display_name: Maledictus native registration, configured attributes and spawn initialization
effects.actual_behavior: MALEDICTUS registry bootstrap constructs this exact class with size1.5Fx3F and fireImmune. The already-captured initializeAttributes event binds Maledictus_Entity.maledictus to MALEDICTUS (not the separately named Ancient Remnant builder). The concrete builder gives baseHP420, attack13, armor10, knockbackResistance1, followRange50, movement0.33F and stepHeight1.25. Constructor calls locked setConfigattribute with installed health/attack multipliers1, initializing configured native health to max; this is not another heal delivery. No explicit armor-toughness attribute is added by this builder. Concrete finalizeSpawn sets tombstone directionSOUTH before delegating to shared finalizeSpawn, which initializes homeTicks400 but does not establish a home position. No concrete mobInteract activation, sleep/necklace/prerequisite-item state or additional phase latch is declared; tombstone encounter creation supplies its own saved home.

effects.display_name: Cursed tombstone Maledictus activation, spawn/home and native retry prerequisites
effects.actual_behavior: Cursed_Tombstone_Block defaults FACING=NORTH/LIT=false/POWERED=false. Its native ticker connects the exact Cursed_tombstone_Entity.commonTick on both sides. While unpowered, cooldownProgress increments until installed CursedTombstoneCooldown1*1200, then a later tick sets POWERED=true. useItemOn requires POWERED AND !LIT, writes LITtrue and returnsSUCCESS; it neither tests nor consumes a specific item and has no local side guard. Powered+lit increments tickCount; tickCount>63 creates native MALEDICTUS before checking ServerLevel/non-null. Server spawn sets position(x+.5,y+2,z+.5), writes block FACING, sets Home=current dimension/tombstone pos, then finalizeSpawn(SPAWNER) overwrites directionSOUTH and initializes shared homeTicks400. It clears offsets X/Z=-1..1,Y=0..5 before addFreshEntity, skipping AIR.defaultBlockState and cataclysm:altar_destroy_immune, using destroyBlock(false) with no local mobGriefing gate. Only addFreshEntity=true triggers final tombstone destroyBlock(false). No attack state, persistence-required flag or target write is added. The branch does not reset tickCount after a failed create/add; if the lit tombstone remains, later eligible ticks retry. Powered+unlit resets tickCount0. Block entity saves only cooldownProgress with putInt; load tests contains("summonCooldownProgress",11) then getInt, so the ordinary saved int does not round-trip through that exact-type admission. tickCount is unsaved. Existing block state persistence and native creation/finalization/add/block hooks remain native.

effects.display_name: Modern Remnant circle/melee attack control
effects.actual_behavior: Goal canUse requires a current alive target; continue only requires a non-null current target. Start enters CIRCLE, selects 120+nextInt(40) circle ticks, radius 8+nextInt(4), random direction and aggression. Circle helper computes t=direction*frame*0.5*speed/radius+offset and navigates to target+(radius*cos(t),0,radius*sin(t)) at speed*moveSpeedMultiplier (both 1 here). Circle expires or linear target distance <5 enters MELEE. Melee navigates at 1, faces target at 30/30, restarts at 120 ticks, otherwise squared distance <=4 and NO_ANIMATION selects the 11-tick bite. Stop randomizes/reset mode state, clears unsuitable creative/spectator target and stops navigation. No explicit local sitting/tame/LOS or team gate is added to this goal.

effects.display_name: Monstrosity native offensive AI sequence
effects.actual_behavior: Priority3 attack goals bind state0->3 smash,6 magma,10 flare,7 absorption,8 shoulder,9 overpower and end at0; priority5 InternalMoveGoal pursues rather than delivering a melee hurt itself. Base attack canUse requires alive nonnull target, strict distance<range and state0; start sets attack state/stops navigation; continue requires active state and ticks<=max. Facing tracks before lookTick, then holds old yaw. Goals are noninterruptible and update every tick; native flags/scheduler remain.

None adds a berserk or awake predicate. Smash adds32%; overpower adds40% and cooldown<=0. Absorption overrides canUse: target alive,state0,isInLava,magazine>=15; it does NOT call base range admission (registered1 is unused here). Magma stop increments magazine and sets240 even if no shot occurred; flare/charge/overpower stop set120/80/160. Positive cooldowns decrement each concrete tick on both sides, even NoAI; reload starts private cooldown defaults0 while magazine persistence is locked R2k4a.

effects.display_name: Ancient Remnant native offensive goal selection
effects.actual_behavior: Offense is selected by native GoalSelector, not a new aiStep selector. Priority3 registers bite, stomp, roar, monolith, charge preparation, tail slam and tail swing in that order; priority2 charge-run and priority1 crash-recovery use InternalStateGoal. Ordinary attack admission reuses live target/distance/start-state, then nextFloat()*100<configured roll and MELEE mode; roar adds cooldown, tail slam grounded/cooldown, tail swing targetY<bossY+1. Monolith overrides admission with three ordered OR branches, each making a fresh 12% roll when reached: targetY>=bossY+8 OR distance>12 OR distance<10, all cooldown<=0, then state0/MELEE. Stomp uses its own noninterruptible/every-tick goal, strict 5.5<distance<20, Y<=bossY+4.5 and 36% roll. Positive concrete cooldowns decrement every tick without a local side/NoAI/sleep gate. Locked prerequisite goals remain unchanged.

Entity hit does not inherently discard either spear.

effects.display_name: Baby Leviathan native aquatic travel and motion controller
effects.actual_behavior: Custom sitting stops a path and passes zero input to parent travel. Otherwise effective AI in water uses moveRelative(speed,input), SELF move and velocity*0.9, adding Y=-0.005 only without target and with NO_ANIMATION. Water controller parameters are speedMulti 3, ySpeedMod 1 and yawLimit 10. Stillness below 0.01F per axis while water/NO_ANIMATION accumulates ticks, adding Y=-0.005 after 40. Active MOVE_TO uses speedModifier*speedMulti*3*MOVEMENT_SPEED; upward collision adds Y=0.08F, otherwise Y += currentSpeed*verticalDifference*0.6*ySpeedMod; water speed factor 0.02F, land 0.1F, pitch limit +/-85 and pitch approach 5. Sitting sets speed zero; absent active path clears speed/input. Preserve ordered writes and native orientation, not knockback.

effects.display_name: Mini Abyss Blast caster persistence and native lifecycle
effects.actual_behavior: Constructor stores runtime LivingEntity caster and server numeric caster ID; client resolves that ID on tick 1. Server only updates mount/aim for a Baby Leviathan caster. NBT writes/reads Yaw, Pitch, Duration and BeamDirection, not caster/ID/on/tick/appear state, so native server reload does not restore the caster and cannot request caster-gated damage. Warmup is 20; on=false after tickCount-20>Duration. ControlledAnimation(3) increases after warmup while on, otherwise decreases; discard occurs when off with timer 0 or caster dead. There is no early return after discard and the later contact branch is not gated by on or caster alive, including fade ticks. push is empty, collision/pushable=false and piston reaction IGNORE; no terrain mutation or death/respawner payload.

effects.actual_behavior: After AnimationHandler update, bite tick 9 calls biteattack(radius 1.5, box inflate 0.5 each axis). effects.display_name: Baby Leviathan native bucket/owner combat lifecycle
effects.actual_behavior: Concrete save/load adds FromBucket only to locked owner/command/custom sit state. Bucket save calls native default data plus concrete NBT in BUCKET_ENTITY_DATA; load reads concrete then default. Tame interactions delegate pickup to native Bucketable.bucketMobPickup. No new owner assignment is made to the releasing player. No custom root death/respawner or offspring/Home contract exists.

effects.display_name: Baby Leviathan native owner follow and teleport
effects.actual_behavior: Custom water follow requires native owner, non-spectator, shouldFollow(Command==1), no alive target and no combat, with start/stop distances 4/2. Combat is owner distance<30 plus alive target. Start stores water malus and sets 0; stop restores it. Every 10 ticks, without leash/passenger, squared owner distance>=144 tries up to 10 random teleports (XZ +/-3, Y +/-1), else navigates at 1.3. Teleport rejects positions within 2 on both X/Z; WATER at position or below is accepted directly, while land requires WALKABLE, !avoidsLand (false here), leaf permission (true here) and noCollision. It moves the pet to block center and stops navigation; water branch does not add a collision check.

effects.display_name: Baby Leviathan aquatic navigation and search admission
effects.actual_behavior: aiStep switches between the concrete aquatic controller/SemiAquaticPathNavigator and native MoveControl/GroundPathNavigatorWide by isInWater. shouldEnterWater=!custom sitting, shouldLeaveWater=false, shouldStopMoving=custom sitting, water search range 32; find/leave goals reuse locked contracts. Aquatic navigator uses native AmphibiousNodeEvaluator(true), always allows updates, clips direct travel against COLLIDER/no fluids and requires a non-air block below stable destinations. Ground waypoint distance is width*0.75, Y difference<1; native stuck detection remains. Random swimming only without target/vehicle/stop state uses native interval 30 and selects fluid/pathfindable destinations, with 0.3 surface attempt and bounded retries. These are native path/search state, not attack damage.
